faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GBPUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GBPUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GBPUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form printed on page 1 of this notice) and send it to Dr. K. C. Verma, Principal Investigator, Department of Biochemistry, College of Basic Science & Humanities, G.B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar-263 145, to reach by 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B. Sc. (Biotechnology, PCM, PCB, Agriculture).

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Keen interest in research work. Scientific writing skill. Experience of phytochemical analysis. Ready for travelling independently.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Interview on 23.11.2026 at 3.00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duration of fellowship up to 12.01.2027. Engagement will be given for six months which may be extended as per requirement.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Department of Biochemistry, CBSH, G.B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar.

faq.answer: Self-attested copies of all certificates, degree and testimonials; Originals to be produced at the time of interview.
